title: Individual humanitarian index datasets — individual_indices
text: Publisher scores retain original scales. Rankings calculated separately within index's exact numeric coverage; missing censored scores ranked. Deciles min(10, floor(10 * (rank - 1) / n_scored) + 1). Ties use minimum rank, 10 20 countries can top_10 top_20 set TRUE. included datasets : inform_risk: INFORM Risk, 2026 v0.7.2. Measures humanitarian crisis disaster risk; higher scores indicate greater vulnerability. inform_severity: INFORM Severity, June 2026. Measures current crisis severity; higher scores indicate greater vulnerability. Coverage publisher's country sheet. underfunded_crisis: Underfunded Crisis Index, 2025. Reports cumulative share requirements funded 2021–2025; lower percentages indicate greater vulnerability. Regional plans excluded. oecd_fragility: OECD Multidimensional Fragility, States Fragility 2025. Measures exposure risk insufficient resilience; lower scores indicate greater vulnerability. public artifact covers 61 high- extreme-fragility contexts. worldrisk: WorldRiskIndex, 2025. Measures disaster risk exposure societal vulnerability; higher scores indicate greater vulnerability. nd_gain: ND-GAIN Country Index, 2026 release using 2024 scores. Measures climate vulnerability adaptation readiness; lower overall scores indicate greater vulnerability. hdi: Human Development Index, Human Development Report 2025 using 2023 scores. Measures health, education, living standards; lower scores indicate greater vulnerability. mpi: Global Multidimensional Poverty Index, 2025. Measures overlapping household deprivations; higher scores indicate greater vulnerability. Reference years vary country survey. ghi: Global Hunger Index, 2025. Measures hunger undernourishment child-health indicators; higher scores indicate greater vulnerability. exact values ranked; censored values ranges remain labels. ghs: Global Health Security Index, 2021. Measures epidemic pandemic preparedness; lower scores indicate greater vulnerability. wps: Women, Peace Security Index, 2025/26. Measures women's inclusion, justice, security; lower scores indicate greater vulnerability. un_mvi: United Nations Multidimensional Vulnerability Index, High-Level Panel results using 2023 data. Measures structural vulnerability lack resilience; higher scores indicate greater vulnerability. debt_distress: IMF debt-distress classification, 31 March 2026. published class paired derived ordinal code 1 (low) 4 (debt distress); intentionally ranked placed deciles. searo: Sexual Exploitation Abuse Risk Overview, 2026 v1.2 using December 2025 data. Measures contextual safeguarding risk; higher scores indicate greater vulnerability. disaster_displacement: IDMC Disaster Displacement Risk Model, GDRM 2.0. Intended report current-climate annual average displacement, higher values indicating greater vulnerability. Values missing snapshot stable country table available. internal_displacement: IDMC Internal Displacement Index, 2022 values published 2023. Measures policy, capacity, drivers, impacts; lower scores indicate greater vulnerability. Numeric coverage 44 countries. clif_vi: Climate Finance Vulnerability Index (CliF-VI), 2025 prototype, 2050 pessimistic projection. Combines climate risk financial vulnerability; higher scores indicate greater vulnerability. Scores cover 188 countries retain publisher precision 0–100 scale. Ranks recalculated 1 denoting vulnerable, reversing publisher's ranking direction. Ranks contribute top-10 top-20 summaries. Climate risk incorporates INFORM Risk 2025 INFORM Climate Change 2022 projections; independent measure current risk. Supplementary governance scores part overall index.

title: globalvuln 0.2.0
text: Added clif_vi: Climate Finance Vulnerability Index 2025 prototype, using 2050 pessimistic projection 188 countries. Includes automated adapter, bundled approved online data, provenance, explorer methodology. Higher scores worse; recalculated ranks contribute top-10 top-20 summaries selected. Fixed combined pipeline validation retain failures warnings instead silently reducing unnamed validation results pass. Recheck source downloads every pipeline run revisions stable URLs detected even discovery metadata unchanged. Added registry-driven targets data pipeline strict validation, change analysis, provenance, atomic publication. Added automated adapters 15 public sources validated manual ingestion adapter IDMC disaster-displacement model. Added globalvuln_data() explicit bundled approved live data access. Added source_status() cadence-aware source freshness information. Added versioned static pins board scheduled update pull requests.
